title: Congress workers detained in Pune ahead of Shah, Doval visit
content: The individuals were taken into custody. The police described the action as a preventive measure. The measure was intended to maintain order during the visit of the Union Home Minister and the National Security Advisor

title: Russian crude imports in July highest since Ukraine war
content: India's crude oil imports from Russia hit a record 2.8 million barrels daily in July. This surge accounted for over half of the country's total crude purchases. Meanwhile, LPG imports heavily favored the United States, supplying seventy-three percent of July's total. Refiners also increased sourcing from West Asian suppliers as Strait of Hormuz flows normalized. Saudi Arabia, Iraq, and Kuwait saw rising exports to India during this period.

title: 'We'll see how it goes': Trump says Iran talks to begin Monday after halting planned strikes
content: US President Donald Trump announced negotiations with Iran would begin Monday.  Diplomatic efforts involving Gulf nations prompted the halt of planned US military strikes.  Mediators are working to revive an understanding regarding the Strait of Hormuz.  Trump expressed hope for a negotiated settlement on denuclearisation and the waterway.  Iranian officials, however, rejected some accounts of formal agreements reached.

title: 39 medals, top-five finish: India ends CWG 2026 with several historic firsts
content: With several medal-rich sports missing from the programme because of financial constraints in hosting the Games — after the event was moved from Victoria in Australia to Glasgow — expectations were lower than in previous editions. Even so, India found success in new events, celebrated new athletes and produced several landmark performances.

title: 10,000 cases pending in SC for 10 yrs, 80,000 in HCs for 30 yrs
content: Despite significant investment, court infrastructure and technology have not reduced decades-old case pendency. Over ten thousand cases remain pending in the Supreme Court for more than ten years. High courts across India have over eighty thousand cases pending for over three decades. The law minister cited judicial responsibility and judicial vacancies as reasons for the delays. New laws and committees have been established to address the growing backlog of cases.

title: Jeff Bezos warns Mamdani on NYC taxes, slams wasteful spending
content: Jeff Bezos commented on New York City's proposed pied-à-terre tax. He suggested that aggressive tax increases could negatively impact tourism and competitiveness. Bezos also criticized targeting individuals, calling it a villain strategy. He argued that government spending inefficiencies are a greater concern than taxation. Bezos previously criticized the city's public school spending and economic policies.

title: Youth quitting drugs real warriors: PM on national drive
content: Prime Minister Modi launched a campaign for drug-free youth for a developed India. He emphasized that families should seek expert help and foster open communication. Youth overcoming addiction are considered warriors and deserve societal respect and second chances. Enemy nations use drug supply as part of terror plans targeting the country's future. The campaign will run for 100 weeks, organizing various de-addiction activities.

title: Nuclear plants, Gaza craters: Google pulls AI tool from Google Earth in 24 hours
content: Google has removed its new AI image generation feature from Google Earth. This action followed immediate concerns raised by researchers about disinformation risks. Experts warned the tool could easily create convincing fake satellite imagery for public deception. Google stated they are implementing stronger safeguards while pausing the feature. The company noted generated images were watermarked as AI-created.

title: Ghana capital turns plastic waste into cheaper street paving
content: Ghana is pioneering a sustainable solution to its plastic pollution crisis by turning waste into economical paving blocks for highways. Led by entrepreneur Nelson Boateng at Nelplast, the initiative compensates plastic collectors, significantly benefiting the community. The resulting paving blocks are not only resilient but also priced competitively against concrete, effectively tackling environmental challenges while providing financial opportunities for many.

title: US study flags hurricane rapid intensification, may give 5-day warnings
content: Coastal communities might soon benefit from enhanced hurricane forecasting. A groundbreaking statistical model predicts rapid hurricane intensification up to five days in advance, significantly improving early warnings. This innovation analyzes a multitude of environmental factors, allowing forecasters to anticipate dangerous storm developments with increased accuracy, ultimately safeguarding lives and property from unexpected hurricane threats.

title: Man buys back grandfather’s 1953 tractor 62 years later, restores it
content: Kevin Klahn restored his grandfather's 1953 tractor after buying it back.  This vintage Allis-Chalmers WD tractor became a symbol of family heritage.  The meticulous restoration project took many hours of dedicated work.  It preserved the machine's original character and historical significance.  The tractor returned home, representing dedication and enduring family bonds.

title: Nanaji Deshmukh Awas Yojana: How workers can avail Rs 1.6 lakh housing aid
content: In Gujarat, registered construction workers have the opportunity to benefit from financial support aimed at housing through the Shree Nanaji Deshmukh Awas Yojana. To qualify, applicants must have been registered with the welfare board for a minimum of two years. Following the acquisition of an e-Nirman Card and house allotment, they can submit their applications. Those approved will receive ₹1.6 lakh to assist in home ownership.

title: West Asia war uncertainty keeps businesses on edge
content: Businesses face significant cost management challenges due to ongoing West Asia conflict.  Commodity inflation and freight charges create persistent planning uncertainties for companies.  This instability may lead to postponed capital deployment and fewer new job additions.  Consumers can expect widespread price increases across various products and services.  Companies are considering further pricing interventions to manage margin impacts.

title: 'Jana Nayagan' Box office collection: Thalapathy Vijay records 37.2% jump
content: Jana Nayagan achieved a significant Rs 10.70 crore on its second Sunday.  The film's India net collection reached Rs 175.60 crore after eleven days.  Overseas markets contributed Rs 3 crore, pushing worldwide earnings to Rs 295.92 crore.  Tamil version occupancy remained strong, especially during evening shows.  This action drama is an official remake of a Telugu film.

title: Lamine Yamal's family struggles shaped his inspiring World Cup journey
content: Lamine Yamal's rise to winning the 2026 FIFA World Cup is inseparable from the story of the family that built him. His mother Sheila Ebana was 16 when she gave birth to him. His father Mounir, a Moroccan immigrant, worked construction and street jobs to stay afloat. His grandmother Fátima crossed from Morocco to Spain alone, undocumented, and worked three jobs to bring her children over. His father survived a life-threatening stabbing in August 2024. Yamal's name itself honours two strangers who helped his parents financially before he was born. This is the full human story behind the boy who hugged his little brother on a World Cup pitch in New Jersey.

title: Brittany Mahomes shares powerful message on motherhood after Patrick's success
content: Kansas City Chiefs star Patrick Mahomes' wife, Brittany Mahomes, shared a heartfelt message about motherhood, leadership and the next generation while celebrating another major milestone beyond football. The Kansas City Current co-owner reflected on why she wants her children to see women in leadership as the norm after helping build one of the biggest success stories in women's sports. Here's what Brittany said during her speech, why she was honored, Patrick Mahomes' loving reaction, and how her impact continues to shape opportunities for women on and off the field

title: Why Aaron Rodgers is CBS’s top choice to replace Tony Romo as analyst
content: Aaron Rodgers has emerged as the leading name in CBS’s search for a possible Tony Romo successor amid growing uncertainty around the network’s top NFL booth. This report explains how the Steelers quarterback entered the broadcasting conversation, what Awful Announcing reported, and why his television future remains far from certain despite public speculation linking him to a major analyst role.

title: MP Pappu Yadav attacked at home during presser
content: An independent MP, Pappu Yadav, faced an alleged attack during a news conference. A man threw a slipper while another reportedly brandished a knife at the event. The incident is believed to be linked to his recent protest outside Parliament. Police have detained one suspect and are investigating the other's involvement. The MP's team claims he had received prior death threats.

title: Househelp apps cross 1L orders as prices fall to Rs 29
content: Snabbit and Urban Company's InstaHelp platforms each completed one lakh house-help jobs on Sunday. Intense competition pushed hourly household work prices down to twenty-nine rupees in some areas. Urban Company offered thirty-minute services for nineteen rupees, a significant discount. InstaHelp promises quick service for various household chores and has expanded rapidly. Both companies achieved this milestone after significant growth in their operations.

title: SC warns Punjab for ignoring 15-yr-old ruling on dues to Himachal Pradesh
content: The Supreme Court criticized Punjab for its resistance to implementing an old decree.  Attorney General Venkataramani proposed a cashless settlement for power dues.  Himachal and Haryana agreed to the proposal, while Punjab raised objections.  The court warned Punjab of consequences if it fails to comply.  A final decision is expected on August 12.

title: DMK slams Congress for 'trading trust for berths'
content: DMK fiercely responded to Rahul Gandhi's criticism of supporting a bill to increase Lok Sabha seats. Senior DMK MP Dayanidhi Maran accused Congress of betraying trust for ministerial positions. The BJP hopes DMK's anger with Congress will aid its legislative agenda. DMK has indicated openness to the bill after studying its impact. Rahul Gandhi's comments acknowledge the possibility of DMK revising its stance on the bill.

title: Investments in PE-VC fall 6% to $20.3bn in Jan-July
content: India's private equity and venture capital investments surpassed twenty billion dollars this year. This figure shows a slight decrease compared to the previous year's performance. July saw investments of three billion dollars, remaining stable from last year's figures. Investors maintain long-term confidence in India's private markets despite global challenges. Sectors like renewable energy and B2B software startups are attracting significant investor attention.

title: 'Counting fingers, not hearts': Shehzad Poonawalla mocks Rahul's Gen Z post
content: Shehzad Poonawalla criticised Rahul Gandhi's recent social media post. He interpreted Gandhi's gesture as counting corruption and bribes daily. Poonawalla accused the Gandhi family of extensive involvement in corruption. Rahul Gandhi had shared a Korean finger heart gesture on Friendship Day. This outreach aimed to connect with younger audiences on social media.

title: Rape victim forced to lick sputum by panchayat in Bihar; FIR filed
content: A woman was forced to lick sputum by a village panchayat in Begusarai.  She had alleged rape by a co-villager on multiple occasions.  The local council instead accused her of an illicit relationship.  An FIR was lodged after a video of the incident went viral.  Police are investigating the video and searching for the rape accused.

title: Deshaun Watson throws six INTs in training camp amid QB battle with Shedeur Sanders
content: In the competition for the Cleveland Browns' quarterback position, Shedeur Sanders is reportedly taking the lead, demonstrating superior performance metrics compared to Deshaun Watson in early practice sessions. Watson has been hindered by interception issues during camp. However, wide receiver Jerry Jeudy appears to support Watson as the preferred starter. The coaching staff will have the final say in this pivotal decision.

title: Ramlila body asks 'Ramayana' makers to hold special screening before release
content: The Shri Ramlila Mahasangh requested a special preview screening of the upcoming Ramayana film. This demand aims to prevent any scenes that might offend Hindu sentiments. The organization warned of protests if their preview request is not accepted. The film's trailer features Ranbir Kapoor as Rama and Yash as Ravana. Ramayana: Part 1 is scheduled for a Diwali 2026 release.

title: 'CJP stands with students': Abhijeet Dipke backs Jharkhand protest
content: Students in Jharkhand continue protests over alleged recruitment exam irregularities. They demand a CBI probe into JPSC and JSSC examination discrepancies. Protesters have lost faith in the current CID investigation into the matter. They seek reforms in the recruitment process and action against responsible officials. The students warn of further escalation if their concerns are not addressed.

title: Delhi lawyer in London reveals why she won’t return to India's corporate
content: Jasleen Kaur, a solicitor now thriving in London, has no plans to return to India for her corporate career. She appreciates the UK’s balanced approach to work-life integration, where employers honor personal time and work hours. This lifestyle allows her to explore her hobbies and nurture personal growth, starkly contrasting with the higher demands and lesser regard for employee welfare found in Indian corporate settings.

title: India's deep-sea bet: Centre's 'Samudra Manthan' to churn crude — How it works
content: India is funding half the cost of deepwater oil and gas exploration wells. This new scheme aims to reduce reliance on imported energy supplies. The government will support sixty exploration wells over the next five years. This initiative encourages companies to explore previously avoided offshore areas. Shared infrastructure will also lower development costs for new discoveries.

title: 5 women killed, 4 injured in lightning strikes in Jharkhand
content: Five women died and four were injured by lightning strikes in Jharkhand's Ramgarh and Godda districts. Three women were killed in Ramgarh while sowing paddy, and two died in Godda. The India Meteorological Department forecast heavy rainfall and thunderstorms for the next four days. A yellow alert has been issued for isolated thunderstorms and heavy rain across several districts.

title: 'Got scholarship, took loan': CJP's Abhijeet Dipke on education expenses row
content: Abhijeet Dipke stated his US education was funded by a scholarship and loan.  He also mentioned the Cockroach Janta Party will use crowdfunding for transparency.  RTI activist Amit Tiwari questioned Dipke's father's financial capacity for US education.  Tiwari filed complaints with the Election Commission and tax authorities regarding the organization.  He also requested an inquiry into the financial assets of Dipke's father.

title: How China's Surveillance Network Follows Foreigners Into Their Homes
content: China already tracks its 1.4 billion citizens through an enormous web of cameras, phone signals and national identity records. Now, the chance discovery by a cybersecurity researcher has shown how far that surveillance reaches when it comes to foreigners too.

title: UP Woman, Husband Strangle Lover Using Saree, Bury Body In The House
content: Rita had married Ram Prakash, who is from the area under Bhadokhar police station, back in 2016, and the couple have two sons together. After a falling out with her husband in 2020, Rita moved back to her maternal home.

title: TVK & Congress not on same page on Cauvery
content:
The Mekedatu dam row has snowballed into a political slugfest in Tamil Nadu,

The Mekedatu dam row has snowballed into a political slugfest in Tamil Nadu, with governing and opposition parties trading barbs instead of closing ranks against Karnataka’s proposed project on Cauvery. The project, opposed by Tamil Nadu, has become a flashpoint after multiple legal and political moves, exposing divisions over how to fight Karnataka’s push. Electricity minister R Nirmalkumar accused DMK of echoing Karnataka CM DK Shivakumar and working against CM C Joseph Vijay. TN Congress president B Manickam Tagore countered that Shivakumar would naturally defend his state, while he would stand for Tamil Nadu “without any party barriers”.

title: Highway deaths dip in India for 1st time since Covid
content:
NEW DELHI: For the first time since the Covid pandemic, fatalities on national highways (NHs) declined last year, even as overall road deaths rose in India. Govt data submitted in Lok Sabha last week shows that deaths on NHs, including Centre-run expressways, fell by 4.1% to 62,122 in 2025 from 64,772 in 2024. Among states and UTs, 20 recorded a decline in fatalities on NHs while 15 reported an increase. Lakshadweep, with no national highways, was the only one to record ‘zero NH fatalities’ since 2022. Data shows UP registered the steepest decline in NH deaths, with fatalities dropping from 9,560 in 2024 to 7,573 in 2025. Madhya Pradesh also reported a significant reduction, from 4,644 to 3,610, along with Punjab, which logged a sharp fall from 1,562 to 1,022 during the same period. States that witnessed a rise in NH fatalities include Tamil Nadu, Maharashtra, Rajasthan, Karnataka, Bihar, Andhra Pradesh and Gujarat.

End of Article
